name: xcoda-ai-marketplace
description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace: source-agnostic requirements and architecture skills for scoping and designing implementations before execution planning.

plugins.name: dod-architect
plugins.description: Author a Definition of Done (DoD) grounded in whatever source material actually exists — documents, transcripts, tickets, existing code, or a prior PRD — rather than a fixed input taxonomy. Mines the sources for architecture-shaping constraints (not just behavior) and pairs each with a concrete design implication, labeled by provenance relationship (Source / Derived from / Must not break). Produces a Markdown DoD, optionally rendered to Google Docs.

plugins.name: spec-architect
plugins.description: Evidence-based architecture and design specification for a single implementation. Five-phase process (Research, Blueprint, Requirements, Design, Validation) produces research.md, blueprint.md, requirements.md, and design.md with a component-level requirements traceability matrix, then validates every acceptance criterion is implemented by a named component and every research claim is cited. Scoped to the 'what' and 'how' of the system's shape only — no execution plan, milestones, or task sequencing.
